description: Command to create a new job via the event bus

_userId.description: Authenticated user's DID, injected by the /bus/emit gateway. Clients do not set this.

resourceId.description: Resource the job operates on. REQUIRED for every jobType EXCEPT 'generation', where it must be ABSENT: the dispatcher derives it from params.context.focus (the context is authoritative) and REJECTS a supplied value via job:create-failed. Both directions are enforced at the dispatcher — this schema cannot express the per-jobType conditionality.
